role37:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE standalone transparent central pixel-art weapon motif for the new Korean sword skill '추격' (pursuit), to be composited inside an existing 48 x 48 game badge. This is a NEW motif; supplied images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY.
Input images: role4 is a reference for ivory steel, dark ink outline and thick pixel clusters; role23 is a reference for blade thickness; role32 is a reference for restraint of effects. Do not copy, redraw, generate or include any surrounding badge, frame, leather or background.
Primary request: Draw ONE unmistakable silver sword making a forceful FORWARD THRUST angled from lower-left hilt toward upper-right tip. Its broad ivory blade is the first thing visible, approximately 3 to 4 logical pixels thick, with a simple crossguard, small dark wrapped grip and round pommel. Place only two or three SHORT subdued turquoise trailing strokes behind the lower-left side of the blade to imply pursuit and momentum converging on the final thrust. The sword remains much larger and brighter than the trailing effect. Clearly different from a purely horizontal sword.
Style/medium: authentic low-resolution hand-clustered pixel art intended to read at actual 48px. Straight stair-stepped chunky hard pixel clusters, a solid near-black brown ink outline, ivory highlight, slate-gray midtone and deep charcoal blade shadow. Muted cyan effect has only one or two shades. No tiny glitter or scattered debris.
Composition/framing: square transparent canvas. Center the isolated motif, with ample completely empty transparent margin, suitable to occupy at most 32 x 30 pixels on a 48 x 48 logical grid. The actual image may be enlarged pixel art but must visually use this small logical grid and native thick pixels. Entire hilt, crossguard, blade and trailing strokes visible, no clipping.
Text: none.
Constraints: truly transparent alpha background. Only ONE sword and two or three short trailing strokes. NO badge, frame, border, shield outline, leather, floor, panel, backdrop, checkerboard, numbers, five separate marks, five swords, lettering or watermark. NO soft glow, gradients, blur, antialiasing or smooth vector art. No gold effect. Preserve simple broad steel silhouette and leave space around it.
